**I cannot compute the embedded emissions for this scenario under the supplied ruleset.**

**Required inputs:**

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the factor table | CN 7202 41 (ferro-chromium) | ❌ **Not in the table** |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | China | ❌ Cannot be confirmed, because there are no table entries for CN 7202 41 |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 1,000 t | ✅ Provided |

**Missing input:**
- **The default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7202 41 (ferro-chromium), country of production China.** The factor table covers only CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. Heading 7202 (ferro-alloys) does not appear.

**Why no estimate is given:**
- The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country. No other row can stand in for this one.
- Using the China factor for pig iron (7201, 1.66) or any other listed good would mean substituting a different product. Ferro-chromium production has a very different emissions profile from iron and steel products, so any such figure would be unsupported.

**To complete the calculation, please provide:**
- A factor table row for **CN 7202 41 / China** with its default SEE (tCO2e per tonne).

With that value, the result would be: Embedded emissions = SEE × 1,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
